previous_statement: Because R=U union V is nonempty, e_R is a nonzero coordinate projection of C^m and ||e_R||=1. The two-sided norm bounds in def-extended-delta-inclusion give (1-t)||e_R|| <= ||w(e_R)|| <= (1+t)||e_R||. Since P_R=w(e_R), it follows that 1-t <= ||P_R|| <= 1+t and therefore | ||P_R||-1 | <= t <= t+epsilon_A. The parent node has already established that P_R is a t-projection. By the registered def-delta-projection, a t-projection is nonvanishing when the second norm alternative | ||P_R||-1 | <= O(t+epsilon_A) holds. The displayed bound proves that alternative with the explicit universal O-constant C=1, since | ||P_R||-1 | <= 1*(t+epsilon_A). Hence P_R is nonvanishing in precisely the sense required by lem-maincb-nested-corner-dimension-transport.
new_statement: Let e_R be the coordinate projection of C^m associated to the nonempty set R=U union V, and put P_R=w(e_R). At level one, the extended t-inclusion w is a t-homomorphism and satisfies the two-sided (1 plus-or-minus t) norm bounds. Since e_R is Hermitian and e_R^2=e_R, involution preservation and the multiplicative-defect axiom give P_R^dagger=P_R and ||P_R^2-P_R||<=t||e_R||^2=t; hence P_R is a t-projection by def-delta-projection. Also ||e_R||=1, so 1-t<=||P_R||<=1+t and therefore | ||P_R||-1 |<=t<=t+epsilon_A. This is the second alternative in def-delta-projection with explicit universal O-constant 1, so P_R is nonvanishing in the sense required by lem-maincb-nested-corner-dimension-transport.
